rasik_suggestions.why: Darbari avaroha requires komal dha to be taken vakra from taar Sa (S' d n P) and resolved definitively through g m R S rather than lingering in a scalar m-g-m loop.

plan.instruction: Reshape the section 6 taan so its melodic peak in the taar register arrives late (past 60% of the section), incorporating Darbari gamak phrasing with nyas on Pa and Re to provide breath before driving seamlessly into the returning sam.
preserve: the mukhada in section 7
the main riff breakdown rhythm

rounds.notes: The doom weight and Darbari atmosphere establish an immense, brooding gravity, but the climax taan falters by peaking prematurely at 46% in an unyielding 32-beat run. Reworking section 6 to peak later in the taar octave and breathe around Pa and Re will give the climax earned majesty and momentum. The surrounding rhythm arrangement and mukhada structure are already locked in and heavy.

rasik_suggestions.change: Insert a half-beat rest after landing on P at the midpoint of the taan, preceding it with a gamak-laden m P g<>m R S phrase
rasik_suggestions.why: Darbari's dignity demands breath and nyas on Pa and Re; an unbroken 32-beat run sounds like generic shredding rather than a heavy Kanada taan.
